label: Color grade
description: Photographic color palettes and tonal grades, including monochrome, film emulations and cinematic treatments.
notes: Finished-image color and tonal treatments belong here, including process-inspired palettes and monochrome grades. camera.film_look owns grain, halation and physical surface artifacts; camera.genre owns shooting conventions, and camera.composition owns spatial symmetry. Values are adjectival grade names that follow “with a” and precede “color grade”; named film looks describe an emulation rather than requiring that capture medium. Grades remain available across depicted eras and genres, and the pastel storybook treatment names a palette without invoking a living director.

values.look: Teal shadows contrast with orange highlights and warm skin, separating cool surroundings from the subject.
Deep blacks, bright highlights and drained color produce a harsh, silvery, high-contrast image.
Colors shift unnaturally, with green shadows, yellow highlights and punchy contrast.
Daylight is darkened and shifted blue, with suppressed bright areas suggesting moonlit night.
The image uses warm brown tones from pale cream highlights to dark chocolate shadows.
Plum shadows and pale gold highlights tint different parts of the tonal range while midtones stay subdued.
Neutral grays replace color, with smooth midtones and detail retained in both shadows and highlights.
Hard whites and dense blacks dominate, with few middle grays and sharply separated shapes.
Lifted gray blacks and softened highlights flatten contrast, while colors appear gently washed out.
Colors become pale and delicate, with soft contrast and bright, airy tones.
Rich reds, clear blues and lush greens stay strongly separated, with dense blacks and luminous highlights.
Warm reds and yellows, deep blues and firm contrast create a dense, saturated slide-film palette.
Dusty browns, ochres and olive greens dominate, with bright artificial hues subdued.
Electric cyan and magenta stand out against near-black shadows, with saturated colored highlights.
Blue-gray tones spread through the image while warm colors and overall saturation are restrained.
Amber highlights and warm midtones give the scene a honey-colored cast without removing other colors.
An olive-green cast covers skin, neutral surfaces and shadows, with deep blacks and yellow-green highlights.
Coordinated candy pink, butter yellow and mint green form distinct color blocks with creamy highlights.
White and gray stay neutral, skin tones remain balanced and colors retain moderate, believable saturation.
Strong, clear colors retain neutral whites and crisp contrast without a dominant overall tint.
One subject or hue remains colored while the rest of the image is black and white.
Prussian blue shadows and white highlights replace the original colors like a blue photographic print.
Mostly neutral black and white gains a restrained purple-brown cast in the darkest tones.
A two-ink palette maps dark tones to navy and lighter tones to vivid magenta.
A restricted red-orange and blue-green palette turns blues teal and renders skin in warm peach tones.
Cool blues, crisp whites and clean, moderately saturated colors give a cooler slide-film finish.
A dense amber-brown cast warms highlights and dirties blues and greens into smoky earth colors.
Pale yellow-green midtones and drained skin color create a stale, uneasy cast without deep green blacks.
Violet-blue shadows and a pale lilac cast cool the image while keeping the brightest highlights nearly white.
Shadow detail collapses into solid black while remaining colors stay rich and strongly saturated.
